note: The keyboard guide says, “confirm a key registers at all and see exactly which ones you have and have not tried yet,” and explains rollover counts, supporting the registration and simultaneous-key checks.
sentence: For the keyboard side of the same input setup, [a keyboard test](/keyboard-test/) checks every key against the same kind of silent-failure question: does it register at all, and how many at once.

note: The touchscreen guide checks “whether every part of the glass still reports a touch” and identifies dead zones as regions where contact is not reported, supporting the description of its screen sweep.
sentence: A phone or tablet screen asks the same question about its own surface, and [a touchscreen test](/touchscreen-test/) sweeps the glass to show which regions stop reporting a finger.
